title: Paul McCartney live: Plains of Abraham, Quebec City | 2008
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Plains of Abraham in Quebec City, Canada, on 20 July 2008.

This show was a celebration of Quebec City’s 400th anniversary, and was seen by over 250,000 fans. It was McCartney’s first concert in Quebec City.

McCartney returned to the Plains of Abraham on 23 July 2013 during the Out There Tour.
